declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 2 of the 10 pending cases qualify: one (Cr No.37/2010, Penukonda PS; CC No.505/2012) includes IPC 420 (cheating), with charges framed 12 Apr 2016; another (RC0372022A0015/2022, ACB Bangalore PS) is an Anti-Corruption Bureau case under Sections 7, 8 and 12 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 alongside IPC 120B. The remaining 8 cases involve only public-order/procedural sections (IPC 34/109/143/149/188/341/353/354/379/411/506, CrPC 151, and a Domestic Violence Act protection application) that do not individually meet the threshold; one of these (Cr No.46/2017, Penukonda PS, IPC 354/506) also has charges framed, 19 Mar 2021. No convictions.
